title: [CRY2-5] The DM admission host accepts any listed member's unordered `DMMembers` replacement, so on
description: Review finding CRY2-5: The DM admission host accepts any listed member's unordered `DMMembers` replacement, so one member can lock the others out (lens CRY2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:150-158, 259; spec/07-compliance.md:285. Fix: Confirmed. The only check is "signed per §13.1.1 by a device key of a DID on the current list". There is no freshness or ordering check, and nothing limits whom a signer may drop. A further impact the reviewer missed: a listed member can also drop the compliance logger DID, which cuts the logger off from the admission key. That conflicts with 04-access-control.md:257 ("A self-Remove never removes a compliance logger") and with §7.8.3. Two parts follow from existing rules without a decision: a `ts` freshness and monotonicity check, as for registrations (10-relays.md:813: "within 300 seconds ... and later than the `ts` of the last request it accepted"), and "a replacement MUST NOT drop a logger DID". Who may drop other members is a genuine design choice. Note that 04:259 currently has the *committer* drop the leaver, so allowing only self-drops would need that flow changed too. Full text: notes/review2/CRY2-verified.md and notes/review2/CRY2.md.
